scripts.name: Host tests
scripts.command: bash -c '. ~/.espressif/tools/activate_idf_v5.5.5.sh >/dev/null; cd firmware && { [ -d managed_components/lvgl__lvgl ] || idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null; } && test/host/run.sh'

scripts.name: Build
scripts.command: bash -c '. ~/.espressif/tools/activate_idf_v5.5.5.sh >/dev/null; cd firmware && idf.py build && python3 tools/secret_scan.py build/cinder.bin build/cinder.elf'
